issues.claim_quote: Across the whole packet, participant experience follows one dominant pattern shown by the cited source.

evidence.quote: Some friends came back pregnant so they were ashamed that they had conceived and dropped out.

issues.mechanism: The evidence describes isolated incidents of pregnancy, shame, and dropout, not a dominant pattern across the entire participant group.
issues.material_consequence: The claim falsely suggests a universal experience, ignoring diverse individual circumstances.
issues.counterconditions: No evidence indicates a consistent pattern across all participants.

review.rationale: The evidence presents fragmented accounts of individual experiences, failing to support a claim of a dominant pattern across the entire participant group. The claim oversimplifies complex situations.
